message.content: {"flag": true, "category": "spoof", "why": "A FlashWire headline claiming Apple confirmed a $400/share cash takeover of itself is an implausible fake-wire item with no basis in surrounding data."}
message.reasoning: The headline claims Apple confirms $400/share cash takeover offer — Apple being acquired? Implausible, fake wire, spoof. Apple at ~$400 takeover... "above market price" — a company can't take over itself. This is spoof/fake wire.
